USS MIGUEL KEITH (ESB-5) MSC CIVMAR Voyage Repair Availability KR

The contractor shall provide all labors, materials, tools, and equipment to accomplish the Voyage Repair Availability for the USS MIGUEL KEITH (ESB-5) as described in accordance with the Work specification MSCOK 26-006 and the SECTION J, Attachment J-1 of the solicitation.

This solicitation is intended only for sources duly authorized to operate and do business in S. Korea as prescribed by DFARS 252.225-7042.

Amendment 0001 issued on 13 Feb 2026 - Include additional work item 0598 Reverse Osmosis Unit Service and Repair

Amendment 0002 issued on 24 Feb 2026 - Provide the revised WI 0510 OWS System Groom in lieu of the current WI 0510_ESB_CSI_Oil Content Meter Calibration (5YR)(SCSI).

Amendment 0003 issued on 7 Mar 2026 - Include additional work item 0401 X-Band Sperry Tech Support.

Amendment 0004 issued on 10 Mar 2026 - Remove the WI 0598 Reverse Osmosis Unit Service and repair from the work package.

Amendment 0005 issued on 11 Mar 2026 - Provide response to the Request for Clarification received.
